semantic.justification: Task200 connects numeric ODFF source to real ScTokenArray/shared FormulaCompiler RPN, ScInterpreter and existing ScFormulaResult inside the actual document-sheet-column formula blocks. Native scalar arithmetic precedence, code/runtime error projection, lazy result state, default bracket completion, forced recalc and logical formula-block events are represented. ScSheetLimits, RTL parsing/cancellation, mdds and shared token/result owners are reused. Formula pointers use JS GC; no physical pointer deletion or reference counting is introduced. Source constructor/service subsets are explicit. References/functions, localized formatter/string conversion, groups/listening/recalc dependencies, serialization/ODS/UI, complete contexts/RNG/caches/vector/hash scheduling and broad parity remain unsupported. Native power fenv-only subnormal classifications reject explicitly. Formula block copy/clone is noncopyable and unavailable semantic equality throws instead of substituting identity. Broad parity/verification flags remain false. Task201 implements valid same-sheet ODFF A1 references through actual ScSingleRefData/ScSingleRefToken/RPN, borrowed document/formula cell views and numeric/empty/direct-text results. Actual shared Svt observers, typed broadcaster stores and native logical FormulaTrack/FormulaTree queues propagate edits and remove subscriptions on replacement/clear. Default dirty context is -1/-1/false; normal noniterative cycles return522; forced/manual modes and inserted-sheet positions are represented. Broad native constructor/service parity remains unverified. JS GC owns physical lifetime; Dispose closes semantic subscriptions/queues only. Cross-sheet/external/range/named references, functions, locale string-to-number conversion, area/group/iteration/deep-recursion services, full context/formatting, formula serialization, ODS and UI remain unsupported. These are bounded implementation slices, not broad native parity.
